[color=#FF0065]
[/color][/list][b][center][size=3]Currently in the works is every color of the rainbow for every building currently in mod as well as seasonal changes to the buildings and the cabin/big shed/fishpond to be added soon![/size]

[size=5][color=#FF0000]N[/color][color=#FFFF00]o[/color][color=#00FF00]t[/color][color=#00FEFF]e[/color][color=#0000FF]s[/color][color=#FF00FE]:
[/color][/size]In this recent update wallpapers and floors was removed unfortunately ... as Asunai has made over 200+ NEW floors AND wallpapers to match this mod and MORE !!!
check out the new content for this mod at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10772//]AT Asunai's Content Pack[/url][/center][/b][list=1]
[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][center][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mj66iy.png[/img]

[/b][/size][/center][/list][center][b][size=3]This mod Allows the User to change all the buildings on the farm to a new design with 3 base colors with a paint bucket from robin ! The rainbow and season changes coming soon to the buildings!!!

[/size][/b][/center][center][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/zuD4GZQ.png[/img][/b][/size][/center][list=1]
[list=1]
[b][size=3]
[/size][/b][/list][center][list=1]
[b][size=3]In order to install this mod you will need:
[/size][/b][/list][size=3][b][url= https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10695/][list=1]
[/list][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]: is a mod loader for Stardew Valley
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246/]Alternative Textures[/url]: Adds the paint bucket and more to the game.
[list=1]
[list=1]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915/]Content Patcher[/url]: allows changes to buildings.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098/]GMCM[/url]: allows the user to be able to change the buildings effortlessly in game.[/list][/b][/size][/center][size=3][list=1]
[b][list=1]
[/list][list=1]
[/list][/b][/list][/size][/list][center][size=3][b]If you have these mods above place the [AT] Change Farm Buildings Colors folder inside the .rar into your stardew valleys directory mod folder.
[/b][/size][list=1]
[/list][b][size=3]Further details in readme text in folder with mod[/size][/b][/center][list=1]
[size=3][list=1]
[b]
[/b][/list][/size][center][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OiWAq1N.png[/img]
[/b][/size][/center][list=1]
[/list][/list][center][size=3][b]once installed its as easy as loading your game going to robin buying the paint bucket at the bottom of the list and using the paint on almost any farm building and the farmhouse walls and floors!!
